items.title: Profile
items.description: Telco and CS Engineer working in VoIP Operations, with a background in Software Programming and Networking. Broad knowledge, from Real-Time Protocols to Infra, with troubleshooting experience. Eager to learn more about SRE, Linux, Networking, VoIP, DevOps, Coding, Monitoring, Cloud Computing, Automation, Microservices and Containers. Enthusiastic about open source, writing and experimenting in a Homelab.

items.title: VoIP Network Engineer
items.description: Professional Services and Support Eng Voice specialist responsible to diagnose and solve complex Call Quality issues in CCaaS and SIP trunk setups between multiple SBC/PBX and a CPaaS, with E2E troubleshooting and Service Delivery.

items.title: VoIP Service Operations
items.description: Capgemini and CELFocus project in the Unified Communications team, with Vodafone One Net and GCC service. SRE-style operations for Red Hat Linux, SIP Trunks, PBX, Weblogic, ActiveMQ JMS Broker and NOKIA mCAS. Development of tools and scripting with bash and python for monitoring and automation. Tier 2 support, fault/change management, release acceptance, on-call, networking troubleshooting, REST/SOAP Web Services, VoIP and SIP flows in the IMS Network.

items.title: Skills
items.description:
- Software Eng programming in Python, Go, Bash, git.
- Linux (RedHat/Debian), Docker containers and Kubernetes Administration.
- Automation and CI/CD with Ansible, Packer, Vagrant and Jenkins.

- Understanding of Networking (TCP/IP), routing and switching.
- Experience in RTC SIP/RTP Protocols, IMS Network, WebRTC, SIP Servers/Proxies (Kamailio).
- Interaction with PostgresDB, InfluxDB and OracleDB.
- Homelab with Proxmox VE virtualization.
